requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user (A1 through C). Gross floor area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), Turin location, and public transport proximity are not energy-efficiency columns and are outside this agent's scope.
User wants the office building to be near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

The building will become a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary. 'Essential' maps to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Energy class, public transport proximity, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1–C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the reference point ascending. The 60-occupant capacity has no matching column, so it is not filtered.
